subject: PromptForge SDK canonical integration plan
messages:
From: Eliot Harris <eliot@promptforge.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora@promptforge.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Exploring a canonical SDK integration with Redwood

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking a quick call intro at KubeCon — PromptForge is keen to build a first-class integration between our prompt-engineering suite and Redwood's hosted/runtime offering. Our immediate goals:

- Ship a trace-forwarding plugin so PromptForge traces (prompt metadata, tokens, trace ids) can be correlated with Redwood invocation logs.
- Provide an installable SDK shim for LangChain and LlamaIndex users so they can opt into automatic telemetry when using PromptForge tools + Redwood models.
- Keep perf overhead <5% token latency.

We sketched a short design doc (attached) and a sample trace harness. Would Redwood be open to a time-boxed pilot (4 weeks) where we implement the shim, run integration tests against your staging endpoint, and produce a joint compatibility matrix + customer-facing docs?

High-level asks: brief architecture call this week, an initial staging API key, and a single SDK contact for coordination.

Attaching: promptforge_integration_design_v1.pdf, sample-trace-harness.zip

Best,
Eliot
Eliot Harris
Head of Partnerships, PromptForge
eliot@promptforge.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Eliot — thanks for the note and the materials. Happy to run a scoped pilot.

Marissa (alliances) and Ben (SDK) are cc'd — they can drive the technical and product side. Proposed next steps:

1) 30-min architecture sync Thursday 11/12 10am PT (we have a block; confirm if that works)
2) We will provision a staging API key and a short-lived dedicated model alias for your harness.
3) Marissa to draft a pilot charter (scope, success criteria, timeline).

Can you confirm which LangChain/LlamaIndex versions you plan to target and whether you expect to support function calling instrumentation in the pilot?

Diego Fernandez
Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Harris <eliot@promptforge.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot charter draft: PromptForge x Redwood canonical SDK integration

Eliot / team — attaching a short pilot charter and scope doc (pf_scope_draft.docx in the attachments list). Key points inline: 

Goal: Validate a production-ready SDK shim for LangChain and LlamaIndex that forwards prompt telemetry + trace ids to Redwood and enables one-click correlation in the Console.

Scope (4 weeks):
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment access (staging API key, test model alias)
- Week 1: Shim dev + basic trace forwarding (LangChain v0.1.12+, LlamaIndex v0.6+)
- Week 2: Integration tests + perf harness (sample-trace-harness.zip)
- Week 3: Docs + sample app + joint compatibility matrix
- Success criteria: end-to-end trace correlation for 95% of traced invocations; per-request overhead <=5% median latency; sample app with README and quickstart.

Risks/assumptions:
- We will use token-sampled traces for initial tests (not full token-level logging).
- Your team will run the perf harness against our staging endpoint and share results.

Deliverables: charter doc, code PR to PromptForge repo, quickstart docs, and an internal SOW if we expand beyond pilot.

Ben — can you confirm perf monitoring hooks (we expose a lightweight trace API and a streaming ingest endpoint) and whether there are any rw API constraints we should call out?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Alliances, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Nora Patel <nora@promptforge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Eliot Harris <eliot@promptforge.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot charter draft: PromptForge x Redwood canonical SDK integration

Marissa — this looks great and matches what we discussed internally. A few clarifying items from engineering: 

- LangChain + LlamaIndex target versions confirmed: LangChain 0.1.14, LlamaIndex 0.6.3. We will also include a tiny shim for the PromptForge SDK so customers who use the PF client directly can opt in.
- Function calling: we want to propagate function call metadata (when a model triggers a function) as part of the trace; can Redwood accept a function_call object in the trace payload?
- Auth: for the staging run, can you provide a short-lived API key and a dedicated ingest endpoint URL?

Attaching an internal design note for our engineers (we will share publicly after the pilot completes). We can use your charter as the basis for an SOW if the pilot looks good.

On Thurs 11/12 at 10am PT works for our team.

Thanks,
Nora Patel
Engineering Lead, PromptForge
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@promptforge.ai>, Eliot Harris <eliot@promptforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot charter draft: PromptForge x Redwood canonical SDK integration

Nora / Eliot — quick technical notes ahead of the call: 

- Function_call: yes, we can accept a function_call object as part of the trace payload. Ideally it should include: timestamp, function_name, inputs (truncated to 2k chars), and a small hash of the output (we avoid storing large function outputs in traces).
- Ingest endpoint: we'll provision a dedicated ingest URL (staging) and issue a short-lived API key (expires in 30 days). Ben to share the URL and key rotation docs during the call.
- Compatibility: we'll validate against LangChain 0.1.12-0.1.14 and LlamaIndex 0.6.0-0.6.3. If you need earlier versions, call it out now.
- Perf: to stay under 5% overhead we suggest: async non-blocking trace send, batch flush at 50ms, and optional sampling (1-10% by default). We'll include a sampling mode in the shim.

Drive folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-promptforge-integ (shared).

See you on the call.

—Ben
Ben Carter
